input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 14 implies a Client election to terminate, but it is drafted as a service-continuation mechanic rather than an express convenience right: it does not state that Client may terminate without cause, gives an indeterminate notice period (effectively 30-60 days depending on when notice is given), is subject to a non-existent "Section 4" (the minimum monthly fee provision), and provides no refund of prepaid fees or protection against early-termination/minimum-fee charges. Section 13 compounds this by pointing termination to "Section 12" (Indemnity) rather than Section 14. Our redline states an express 30-day Client convenience right with a pro-rata refund and no penalty, confirms TrueLink has no mid-term convenience exit (leaving its mutual end-of-term non-renewal right on 30 days' notice intact, which is acceptable), and corrects the cross-reference.

proposal.summary: Make Client's convenience termination explicit (30 days' notice, pro-rata refund of prepaid fees) and confirm TrueLink has no mid-term convenience exit; fix cross-reference to the termination section.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have clarified Section 14 so that we may terminate for convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice with a refund of prepaid fees and no early-termination penalty, and confirmed TrueLink cannot exit for convenience mid-term (its end-of-term non-renewal right is unaffected). We also corrected Section 13's cross-reference, which pointed to the indemnity section rather than the termination section; we can move to 60 days' notice if that is easier operationally.

ops.oldText: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
ops.newText: 14. TERMINATION. Client may terminate this Agreement for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to TrueLink. TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services through the effective date of termination specified in such notice, and Client will pay TrueLink's fees for Hosting Services and Support Services provided through such effective date. TrueLink shall refund to Client any prepaid fees for the period after such effective date, and no early termination fee, penalty or minimum-fee obligation shall apply. TrueLink shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience prior to the end of the then-current term.

ops.oldText: until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein
ops.newText: until terminated pursuant to Section 14 herein
